summary: {person} asks the director to price a same-day trip separately from a scheduled van ride.
realLife: Milwaukee’s advisory council heard an August per-trip cost for the same-day pilot alongside a substantially lower average for regular van trips.
gates: A pilot faces a funding decision and comparable trip-cost data are available.
weights: A pilot nearing the end of its appropriation makes the distinction urgent.
inGame: needs: pilot expenditures, completed trips and comparable regular-service costs.

turns.what: The analyst reconciles what each includes.
turns.pulledBy: The two figures cover different expenses.

turns.what: A rider explains when advance booking is impossible.
turns.writesBack: Keep the service need beside the cost comparison.
